ns2:section.sectionText: Documentary is the fastest growing area of television journalism and non-fiction filmmaking today. This Discovery Course is for students who want to expand their knowledge of and appreciation for documentaries in all their forms. Using weekly in-class screenings, discussions, readings, and writing, students will examine a wide variety of documentaries, looking at their styles, purposes, and storytelling voices, as well as learning the language and other fundamentals of documentary. The course will also cover the basic methods for creating a documentary and look at some possible work and career opportunities. Please note: this is NOT a hands-on filmmaking or video production course. Professor Jay Rosenstein is a Peabody Award and multiple regional Emmy Award winning documentary producer and director, who brings his many years of experience into the classroom. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course.
